pages.text: Moving Earth is not the witch's art of lifting one neat pillar. It is a greater sundering, a broad working that parts the land itself and sends the broken line wandering outward from the circle.$(br2)Where Broken Earth is a sharp trench cut, Moving Earth is a sustained rift.

In the live port this rite is worked from a $(bold)large ritual circle$(/) through representative earth offerings: $(item)Dirt$(), $(item)Gravel$(), or $(item)Sand$(). Once accepted, it does not resolve at once. The working becomes a staged rite that walks a tearing path away from the circle over time.

pages.title: A Wider Parting
pages.text: Nearby Coven Witches strengthen the cast by widening the broken path. Use it when you mean to divide a field, break pursuit lines, or reshape the ground in a way that feels less like mining and more like commanding the earth to move aside. The port's trigger item is still a simplified stand-in, but the live terrain behavior now follows the old earth-parting spirit much more closely.
